limitations: Not a predictive model: a keyword-retrieval pass over DDR narratives, tagged extraction:"rule" on every Issue it produces, not something trained or validated.

Precision is not self-certified here: a bare keyword match (e.g. "power loss") can false-positive against a cluster it does not semantically belong to — observed during development on real data, not from a formal review.
No manual-review CSV exists yet for a representative sample of candidates.
The optional LLM extraction pass (07 §10) is not built; every Issue here is rule-only.
validation: Rule lexicon (07 §10); manual-review precision pending — see tasks/BACKLOG.md's "Needs Sergei" list.
